title: Counterspeakers’ Perspectives: Unveiling Barriers and AI Needs in the Fight against Online Hate

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews evaluating user concerns that AI tools are trained primarily on Western data and lack the cultural context to accurately understand or counter hate speech globally (e.g., comparing US and Cameroon contexts).

Analysis of user surveys and interviews to identify and evaluate participants' functional doubts, distrust, and concerns regarding AI systems potentially encoding societal biases and negatively impacting minorities.
